literal: The Grand Marshal sounded the drum to tighten the encirclement; the assembled armies beat drums, shouted, and sounded warning horns until they stopped at the Xuanwu Field.
idiomatic: The Grand Marshal sounded the drum to tighten the encirclement; the assembled armies beat drums, shouted, and sounded warning horns until they halted at the Xuanwu Field.

literal: The Grand Marshal encamped at the northern banner gate;
idiomatic: The Grand Marshal encamped at the northern banner gate;

literal: The two wing commanders encamped at the left and right banner gates;
idiomatic: the two wing commanders encamped at the left and right banner gates;

literal: The Palace Central Gentleman led the capture-cart units to enter and take position to the right inside the northern banner gate.
idiomatic: and the Palace Central Gentleman led the capture-cart units to enter and take position to the right inside the northern banner gate.

literal: The emperor entered through the southern banner gate to shoot game.
idiomatic: The emperor entered through the southern banner gate to shoot game.

literal: The Usher used the capture carts to collect and load the game, then returned and displayed it north of the capture banners.
idiomatic: Ushers used the capture carts to collect and load the game, then returned and displayed it north of the capture banners.

literal: Princes, dukes, and those below shot game in turn, each sending it to the capture banners and delivering it to the stewards who collected game.
idiomatic: Princes, dukes, and those below shot game in turn, each sending it to the capture banners and delivering it to the stewards who collected the game.

literal: The affair was finished.
idiomatic: The affair was finished.

literal: The Grand Marshal sounded the drum to release the encirclement and encamped again; the Palace Gentleman led his subordinates to collect game, filling the capture carts to supply the kitchens.
idiomatic: The Grand Marshal sounded the drum to release the encirclement and encamped again; the Palace Gentleman led his subordinates to collect game, filling the capture carts to supply the kitchens.

literal: A report was submitted to the chief kitchen of the unified bureau; wine vessels and sacrificial meat were placed in the central crossroads to feast the assembled armies of the military hunt.
idiomatic: A report was sent to the chief kitchen of the unified bureau; wine vessels and sacrificial meat were placed at the central crossroads to feast the assembled armies of the hunt.

literal: At the hour of shen, the duty Attendant-in-Ordinary judged the occasion and announced martial alert; attendant officials returned to vermilion robes; halberds were resheathed.
idiomatic: At the hour of shen the duty Attendant-in-Ordinary judged the occasion and announced martial alert; attendant officials returned to vermilion robes and halberds were resheathed.

literal: At the second alert, the officials placed in advance returned first.
idiomatic: At the second alert the officials placed in advance returned first.

literal: Two quarters after the third alert, the duty Attendant-in-Ordinary announced: "The outer preparations are complete.
idiomatic: Two quarters after the third alert the duty Attendant-in-Ordinary announced: "The outer preparations are complete.

literal: The emperor wore a black kerchief cap and unlined robe.
idiomatic: The emperor wore a black kerchief cap and unlined robe.

literal: The duty Attendant-in-Ordinary, Regular Palace Attendant, Yellow Gate Attendant-in-Ordinary, and military officers advanced on either side of the imperial seat.
idiomatic: The duty Attendant-in-Ordinary, Regular Palace Attendant, Yellow Gate Attendant-in-Ordinary, and military officers advanced on either side of the imperial seat.

literal: The duty Attendant-in-Ordinary knelt and announced: "Return to the palace.
idiomatic: The duty Attendant-in-Ordinary knelt and announced: "Return to the palace.

literal: The alternate Attendant-in-Ordinary proclaimed the command: "It is permitted.
idiomatic: The alternate Attendant-in-Ordinary proclaimed the command: "It is permitted.

literal: The duty Attendant-in-Ordinary bowed low and rose.
idiomatic: The duty Attendant-in-Ordinary bowed low and rose.

literal: The imperial carriage mounted the palanquin and returned; the guard and escort followed the usual rite.
idiomatic: The imperial carriage mounted the palanquin and returned; the guard and escort followed the usual rite.

literal: The Grand Marshal sounded the drum to disperse the encampments; each returned to quarters in order.
idiomatic: The Grand Marshal sounded the drum to disperse the encampments; each returned to quarters in order.

literal: As the imperial carriage was about to arrive, the guard of honor called: "Lead the garrison filling the streets and the front attendant officials placed in advance to their positions.
idiomatic: As the imperial carriage was about to arrive, the guard of honor called: "Lead the garrison filling the streets and the front attendant officials placed in advance to their positions.

literal: They bowed twice.
idiomatic: They bowed twice.

literal: When the imperial carriage reached the hall and turned the palanquin, the duty Attendant-in-Ordinary knelt and announced: "Descend from the palanquin.
idiomatic: When the imperial carriage reached the hall and turned, the duty Attendant-in-Ordinary knelt and announced: "Descend from the palanquin.

literal: The alternate Attendant-in-Ordinary proclaimed the command: "It is permitted.
idiomatic: The alternate Attendant-in-Ordinary proclaimed the command: "It is permitted.

literal: The duty Attendant-in-Ordinary bowed low and rose.
idiomatic: The duty Attendant-in-Ordinary bowed low and rose.

literal: The imperial carriage descended and entered.
idiomatic: The imperial carriage descended and entered.

literal: The duty and alternate Attendants-in-Ordinary, Regular Palace Attendants, Yellow Gate Attendants-in-Ordinary, Regular Attendants-in-Ordinary, and military officers followed to the gate, likewise according to the usual rite.
idiomatic: The duty and alternate Attendants-in-Ordinary, Regular Palace Attendants, Yellow Gate Attendants-in-Ordinary, Regular Attendants-in-Ordinary, and military officers followed to the gate, likewise according to the usual rite.

literal: The duty Attendant-in-Ordinary announced: "Release martial alert.
idiomatic: The duty Attendant-in-Ordinary announced: "Release martial alert.

literal: Inner and outer officials submitted memorials of inquiry according to the usual rite; when finished, it was dismissed.
idiomatic: Inner and outer officials submitted memorials of inquiry according to the usual rite; when finished, the rite was dismissed.
